before_metrics.comment: exp-20260527-005 had zero rows in any pead-eligible bucket; comparison was structurally impossible.

change_summary: Reads the enriched watchlist from exp-20260527-908 and computes three read-only bucket comparisons at 5d/10d horizons: (1) residual vs non-residual within PEAD window, (2) PEAD-window vs outside-window primary positive, (3) positive-revision PEAD vs non-primary baseline. Mirrors exp-20260527-005 gate_thresholds. Result: residual leadership inside the PEAD window has a -3.6 pp 5d return lift vs non-residual (residual avg -2.0% vs non-residual +1.6%), and a -19.6 pp win rate lift. The 10d horizon shows a small +0.7 pp flip but with sample sizes below the published min_bucket_closed_10d=5 floor. Hypothesis rejected at the 5d primary horizon.
decision_rule: Gate 4: if residual_eligible avg_return @ 5d minus non_residual_eligible avg_return @ 5d is negative, reject. Else if bucket size floor + concentration limits pass AND lift >= 0.01, accept. Else, observed_only_thin_bucket_data_now_available.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Within the T+2..T+15 PEAD window, residual leaders among positive expectation revision rows should outperform non-residual peers at 5d/10d horizons.
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260527-005/008/009/010 all observed_only_data_gap due to missing last_earnings_date and sector/theme residual coverage; exp-20260527-908 unblocked the field.
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: Residual leadership flag within the T+2..T+15 post-earnings window on positive expectation revision rows.
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: 5d horizon lift >= +1.0 pp with closed_5d >= 8 per bucket and concentration limits passed.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Single deterministic script reading exp-20260527-908 artifact; 10 unit tests cover bucket assignment, stats, comparison, gate accept/reject/observed_only logic.

hypothesis: With last_earnings_date now PIT-joined by exp-20260527-908, the PEAD continuation alpha line can finally be tested directly: (a) within the PEAD window, do residual leaders outperform non-residual primary positive rows at 5d and 10d horizons (b) does the PEAD window itself produce a return lift over primary positive rows outside the window (c) does positive expectation revision + PEAD window beat the non-primary-positive baseline.
next_evidence_needed: Accumulate multiple earnings seasons before retrying residual-leadership as a PEAD discriminator. The non-residual eligible bucket showed a meaningful +1.57% 5d return on its own (win 62.5%); a weaker hypothesis -- 'positive expectation revision + PEAD window without requiring residual leadership' -- may still be worth measuring at scale. Add sector/theme residual control before the next retry, given exp-20260527-009/010 evidence that SPY/QQQ-only residual is a weak proxy.
rejection_reason: 5d residual eligible avg return -2.03% underperforms non-residual eligible +1.57% by 3.60 pp; win rate also lower by 19.6 pp; bucket size floor and concentration limits also fail.
